data.notes: I kept the research short (12 searches, extended mode). Main dimensions and trunk volumes are covered for all current generations. Several predecessor values and the 48V mild-hybrid trunk of the X1 U11 are still open, so they are null and listed in notFound. The iX1 is a variant of X1 U11. The iX3 is its own model with two generations (G08 2021-2025 based on X3 G01, and the Neue Klasse NA5 from 2026), because the NA5 is not an X3 variant. Mild-hybrid models of the 1er F70 and 2er Active Tourer U06 have noticeably smaller trunks because of the 48V battery (1er: 300 vs 380 L, 2er AT: 415 vs 470 L).
